title: Send search
searchPlaceholder: Name, email or mobile of an agent or supervisor…

campaign.label: Campaigns
campaign.loadFailed: Could not load the campaign list

source.markDone: Marked {{count}} campaigns associated with «{{name}}» (#{{id}}) — by record or by the current mapping
source.markAlready: All {{count}} campaigns of «{{name}}» (#{{id}}) are already marked — nothing changed
source.markNone: «{{name}}» (#{{id}}) has no campaigns in the selected range — nothing was marked
source.markTooMany: Marking «{{name}}» would reach {{count}} campaigns and the maximum is {{max}}. Narrow the date range and try again — nothing was marked

a11y.cellMapped: Data source per the current mapping: {{name}}, id {{id}}. No source was recorded at send time.
a11y.cellDeleted: Data source: {{name}}, id {{id}} — deleted source. The send itself is recorded.
a11y.cellDeletedMapped: Data source per the current mapping: {{name}}, id {{id}} — deleted source. No source was recorded at send time.
a11y.cellNoRecord: No data source was recorded for this send.
a11y.cellNameNotFound: Data source: id {{id}}. The source name is unavailable.

includeOverOneYear: Include sends older than one year (the search will take longer)

tooltip.recorded: The version was recorded at the moment of the send — this is the version that was actually sent.
tooltip.inferred: There is no send record for the version, but the mapping has not been changed since the send — so this is the version that was sent.
tooltip.unverifiable: The mapping was changed after the send — which version was sent cannot be established with certainty.

drawer.rowValues: The values sent to this recipient
drawer.noRowValues: No source row was sent for this recipient — the tokens were sent empty
drawer.coverageCaveat: These are counts, not percentages: email has no delivery receipt, SMS has no open metric, and a recipient may have been reached on more than one channel — so the denominator differs per channel.
drawer.rosterReconstructed: This recipient list is reconstructed from the current mapping and is not a record of who was actually sent to.

footnote.tracking: Open and click data come from tracking and are not available on every channel; no recorded activity is not proof the message went unseen.

error.permissionDenied: You do not have permission to view recipient details

export.title: Export search results
export.tooltip: Export every result matching the current filters
export.disabledNoRows: There are no results to export
export.rowCount: {{n}} rows will be exported — every result matching the current filters, not just the page on screen.
export.criteriaTitle: The filters that will be recorded in the file
export.criteriaNote: These rows are written at the top of the file exactly as shown here, so the file documents the search that produced it.
export.zeroPrefixNote: The Excel (.xls) file keeps the leading zero in phone numbers; the CSV does not, and Excel may show 052… as 52…. Open the Excel version when the numbers matter.
export.notifyEmail: Email me when it is ready (optional)
export.notifyEmailHint: Leave it empty and the file will still be waiting on the downloads page.
export.readyBoth: Two versions were produced: CSV and Excel.
export.readyCsvOnly: Because of the number of rows, only a CSV file was produced — no Excel version.
export.runningInBackground: The file is being prepared. We will email you when it is ready, and it will appear on the downloads page.
export.runningInBackgroundNoEmail: The file is being prepared. No email address was given, so you will be notified through the notifications bell and the file will wait for you on the downloads page.
export.invalidRequest: The request was rejected: one of the export details is not valid. Check the notification email address, and reduce the number of selected campaigns or filters. Trying again unchanged will be rejected again.
export.tooManyRows: The current search has {{rows}} rows, and the export limit is {{max}}.
export.tooManyRowsHint: Narrow the search — a shorter date range, specific campaigns, or one more filter — and try again.
export.inProgress: Another export is already running. Wait for it to finish and try again.
export.notAllowed: You do not have permission to export these results.
export.failed: The export failed. Try again, and contact support if it keeps happening.
export.unknownOutcome: The connection dropped before the server answered. The export may still have completed.
export.unknownOutcomeHint: Check the downloads page before exporting again — exporting now could create a second copy of the same file.

criteria.campaignsPartial: {{n}} campaigns: {{list}}. The entries marked with # are not in the campaign list that was loaded (they may fall outside the selected date range) — the filter still applies to them in full.
criteria.campaignsNamesUnavailable: {{n}} campaigns: {{list}}. The campaign name list could not be loaded, so some campaigns are identified by number only.
criteria.dateNoLimit: No date limit — includes sends older than one year
criteria.dateClampedValue: The selected range is wider than 12 months, so the search was narrowed automatically to the last 12 months and this file does not contain sends from before that. To cover the full selected range, tick "Include sends older than one year" and export again.
criteria.includeOverOneYear: Includes sends older than one year
criteria.sortNotGuaranteed: The sort may not have been applied
criteria.sortNotGuaranteedValue: The sort is applied only when the selected field exists as a searchable column in the data-source versions of the campaigns included in the search. If it does not, the server returns the results in the default order — by send time, newest first — and does not report it. To check in this file: if the "Sort value" column is empty on every row, the requested sort was not applied.
criteria.incompleteRulesValue: {{n}} filters were left without a value and were therefore not applied to the results

preview.title: The email that was sent
preview.disabled: The email cannot be shown: the server supplied no preview link for this row (a non-email channel, or a missing recipient or campaign id).
preview.noTrackNote: This preview is not recorded as an open by the recipient, and the links inside it are disabled.

adv.unavailable: There are currently no fields available to filter by
adv.incomplete: Missing a value — this filter is not applied
adv.partialWarning: This field does not exist in every campaign in the results. Filtering by it will return no rows from the campaigns that lack it.

empty.title: There are no fields to filter by
empty.body: Filterable fields are defined on the Data Sources screen: mark a column as searchable in the source settings and it will appear here on the next send.

sort.label: Sort by
sort.hiddenFieldNote: The sort uses a field that is not a column of the grid. Each row's sort value is shown in the "Sort value" column.
